name: 45 degree one leg hyperextension (arms in front of chest)
description: A single-leg back extension on a 45 degree bench that trains the glutes, hamstrings and lower back one side at a time.
instructions: Set the pad under your hips and hook one foot under the roller, with the other leg lifted off.
Cross your arms over your chest and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your torso toward the floor with a flat back.
Raise back up by squeezing your glute until your body is level, without overarching.
Complete all reps, then switch legs.
